notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist or has moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Featured repositories are selected in the config, enriched with GitHub metadata, and summarized from indexed project data.

activity.title: Engineering news feed
activity.intro: Recent commits become readable, AI-written updates. With an AI key they are generated during sync; otherwise a deterministic fallback is used.
activity.empty: No activity has been indexed yet.

ask.title: Ask about this developer
ask.intro: The ask layer is grounded in indexed portfolio content: config, selected repositories, commits, releases, skills, and experience. When no AI key is configured, it returns a transparent local fallback.
ask.placeholder: Ask about experience, projects, stack, or recent activity
ask.helper: Answers are constrained to indexed portfolio data and config content.
ask.error: The ask endpoint could not answer right now.
ask.emptyState: Submit a question to query the indexed profile, projects, commits, releases, skills, and experience.
examples: What kind of engineer is this developer?
What stack does this portfolio use?
